notes.title: Still on Track — and at Ukrainian Games Festival 2025!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805909/23524831c395a49aae15a8cdfa4cbb32bec4de09.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey friends,[/p][p]We might have been a little quiet lately, but don’t worry — [b]4 Days in[/b]* is still very much alive, and we’ve been making steady progress behind the scenes.[/p][p]And now we’ve got something fun to share: we’re part of the [b]Ukrainian Games Festival 2025[/b]!
It’s a perfect chance to celebrate all the amazing games being made here in Ukraine — and to remind you that ours is on the way, too.[/p][p]You can check it out here [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ukrainiangames2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ukrainiangames2025[/url][/p][p]We know the “Coming Soon” sign has been hanging for a while, but we’re getting closer, and some proper news is coming soon™. In the meantime, your wishlists and kind words mean the world to us.[/p][p]See you on the festival page — and stay tuned for what’s next.[/p]

notes.title: We're Thrilled to be Part of the Ukraine Games Festival!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43805909/c43da85bb4262e34e1575efec53f7e035f301065.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone,

We're excited to announce that [b]4 Days in ***[/b] is participating in the [b]Ukrainian Games Festival 2024[/b] on Steam!

This festival highlights the incredible creativity and talent of Ukrainian developers, and we’re honored to be part of it.

You can find it here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/UkrainianGames2024

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: Controller Support Patch
notes.content:
We have added controller and keyboard support to make it easier for you to navigate the menus and diary. There are also a couple of small changes.
Changes:
[list]
[*] Controller Support
[*] Keyboard in menu and diary
[*] New menu
[*] Added ash particles
[*] Fixed some bugs
[/list]
